data: Binance public announcement archive (www.binance.com CMS list API, titles + release timestamps; research_data/binance_announcements): catalog 161 Delisting, 49 Latest News

events.spot delisting: titles 'Binance Will Delist <tickers> on <date>' (not 'Futures Will Delist'); tickers parsed from the title
events.monitoring tag: titles containing 'Monitoring Tag to Include <tickers>' (or 'Monitoring Tag Applied' with tickers)
events.futures delisting: titles 'Binance Futures Will Delist ... <SYM>USDT ... Perpetual' with the symbols in the title (titles saying 'Multiple' are skipped: tickers not in the title)

rule: for each event coin with a Binance USDT perp in the point-in-time data that has a bar in the hour of the announcement: short 0.05 from the first whole hour after the release time (listing_live timing), hold H days or until the perp data ends, cover for good at +30% from the entry close; merged with the v9.7 listing short in one 'event short' sleeve (one position per coin, gross cap 0.5); 10 bp; real funding. H = 14 for spot / futures delisting, 30 for monitoring tag

trials.C + all three: listing short + spot delisting + monitoring tag + futures delisting

pass: replaces the listing-short sleeve; strict rule vs v9.7; with several passes the highest 2022-26 Sharpe
